apps.name: Tuna
apps.subtitle: Your music at home.
apps.localizedDescription: Your music from your Tuna server, with mixes and lyrics. Download songs to play offline.

versions.localizedDescription:
Changed
- Covers show at once. Every album's cover is made ready ahead, a minute after Tuna starts and then every 6 hours for new albums, so the first time a page shows them they no longer come in one by one. Browsers and the apps now keep covers for good instead of a week.
- Pages open at once. Each device keeps what Home, the library, playlists and the last albums and artists showed, for the person signed in, and opens on that while the server answers. Signing out removes it.

To update: the server (pull the new image); the apps don't need updating.
